title: Shape of a serialized transition record
statement: For every one-work-tape binary machine action with successor state either absent or an index $q$, its serialized record is the list of its eight fixed action bits, followed by $u$ copies of $1$ and a terminating $0$, where $u=0$ if the successor is absent and $u=q+1$ if it is present.
hypotheses_covered: The action is for a one-work-tape binary machine
The state set has size $n+1$ for some natural number $n
replaced:
The serialized record of any one-work-tape machine action decomposes as its
eight fixed action bits, followed by a block of $1$s whose length is the
unary size of the optional successor field (zero when the action halts, one
more than the successor index otherwise), followed by a single terminating
$0$.
